derivation: from H2801 (חָרַת) (but equivalent to H2793 (חֹרֶשׁ)); forest;

occurrences.text: And the prophet Gad said unto David, Abide not in the hold; depart, and get thee into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.
